# CRM: Orlavine onboarding

Date: 6 Oct 2025  
Activity: Deal-desk handoff  
Customer: Orlavine Medical Supply  
Product: Pemberline Dock  
Order form: Live 1 Oct 2025; 50 seats; 5% discount  
Status: Onboarding tasks open

Orlavene onboarding packet sent to the shared implementation queue. Order form attached to the CRM record; copied the seat count and discount into the handoff so nobody has to excavate a PDF before coffee.

Ops sent a sample arrival sheet for the Mountain West receiving team: carrier, trailer, appointment time, dock door. Door 4 appears twice under slightly different labels. Asked them to pick one label before import, unless we want two versions of the same door enjoying independent careers.

The first-shift dispatcher wants late arrivals visible without opening each booking. Added that to the walkthrough agenda, along with moving an appointment between doors.

Next: clean up the sample CSV, check the missing contact email, and resend the cal invite. Attachement name still says “final2”; leaving that small monument alone for now.
